title: Additive-error graph model of the Euclidean plane
exact_target: Can the whole Euclidean plane be represented by a unit-edge graph with uniformly bounded additive distance error, including with bounded degrees?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 10000005 (AMR-099-0005). CC BY 4.0.

Itai Benjamini, \emph{Coarse Geometry and Randomness}, Saint-Flour lecture notes, version dated 30 October 2013; original author manuscript preserved in Arquivo.pt capture of 31 December 2020, Definition 1.25 and Open Problem 1.32, pp. 9--10.
